channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Community Center Garage (UCSF Mission Bay) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Community Center Garage (UCSF Mission Bay): Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the…
item.description: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources differ'); the disputes, quoted excerpts and hedging moved to this record's open questions, with every source still named. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · Community Center Garage (UCSF Mission Bay): The Community Center Garage page now…
item.description: The Community Center Garage page now cites UCSF's Brain Tumor Center parking page, which lists a Community Center Garage at 1625 Owens St, as the source of the address. It also says what DataSF's building-footprint data shows: one footprint runs across the Rutter Center and about 40 percent of the area drawn here, so the data has no boundary between the two. The painted stalls and the rooftop deck remain Pier & Point's own reading of satellite imagery. Source: https://braintumorcenter.ucsf.edu/contact/ucsf-mission-bay-campus; https://data.sfgov.org/resource/ramy-di5m.json?eas_address_id=731845.

item.title: Correction · Community Center Garage (UCSF Mission Bay): The page now notes that a 2021 city…
item.description: The page now notes that a 2021 city permit record lists an existing 8-story public parking garage at 1625 Owens Street. Who built it, and when, is still not known. Source: https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?$where=block=%278709%27%20and%20lot=%27011%27.

item.description: Added a sourced dossier for Community Center Garage. Source: https://braintumorcenter.ucsf.edu/contact/ucsf-mission-bay-campus.

item.title: Correction · Community Center Garage (UCSF Mission Bay): The garage record said a real rooftop…
item.description: The garage record said a real rooftop deck with painted striping was visible in satellite imagery, that it stood beside the William J. Rutter Community Center and was joined by a walkway, and that the area was the 1625 Owens St parking lot. UCSF's June 2025 CAC map supports only an existing garage labeled 'Community Center Garage (21A)' beside 'Rutter Center (21B)'. The record now says so, marks the rooftop deck, walkway and striping as Pier & Point's own satellite reading (not cited), drops the full Rutter Center name, and flags that the 1625 Owens St address is unsourced. Source: UCSF, Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC presentation, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf).
item.source: UCSF, Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC presentation, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf)

item.title: Milestone · Community Center Garage (UCSF Mission Bay): UC Regents Committee on Grounds… (May 2000)
item.description: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings item (May 17, 2000) for the Mission Bay community center building says an 'interim parking lot will be developed at the northwest corner of the building until a parking structure can be built in a later phase of campus development'; the item is about the community center, not the garage (May 2000). Source: UC Regents, 2000-05-17.
